name: Hangzhou EZVIZ Network Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou EZVIZ Network Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of smart home products in China and internationally. The company provides security cameras, including wire-free, indoor and outdoor Wi-Fi, 4G security, and PoE cameras, as well as accessories comprising solar charging panels, solar panels, battery solar panels, power partners, PoE splitter, X5S, transformers, wall mount brackets, and microSD cards.
